pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Ashfeather Fire Owl nests upon scorched cliffs, its feathers glowing like dying embers. A silent nocturnal hunter, it watches the land below from high perches. Others dwell among the Nether's basalt deltas, where volcanic heat surrounds them without rest.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: In badlands, eroded badlands, and jagged peaks above Y=140 at night. Also found in basalt deltas without height or time restrictions. Requires a clear perch or a position 10–24 blocks above terrain.
